title: Observer Intelligence Action Authorization
description: Final gate. Must re-validate Authority Token binding and evidence freshness. A stored 'authorized=true' flag without re-validation is non-compliant.

authority_token_ref.description: Authority Token ID presented for this decision.

reconciliation_ref.description: Reconciliation Record ID that the token (and this decision) rest on.

binding_verified.description: MAC/signature over the token fields was re-checked at authorization time.

scope_match.description: Requested action is within the token's exact scope.

time_window_valid.description: Current time is within not_before .. not_after.

evidence_refs_still_resolvable.description: All evidence_refs on the token still resolve to retrievable records.

failure_reasons.description: Populated when any revalidation check fails.

escalation_flag.description: True if the decision was escalate (or if refuse/abstain was chosen because of unresolved high-severity issues).

process_metrics.description: Optional but recommended for development; required for any claim of OI process correctness.

independence_estimation_error.description: Error vs ground-truth independence when available; null if unknown.

contradiction_preservation.description: Whether known contradictions remained visible in the reconciliation lineage.

decision_rationale.description: Short machine- or human-readable reason. Must not replace lineage.
